# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Performance and platform reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves graphics performance, platform integration, and resource handling across Android, Linux, WebAssembly, and native rendering. This unreleased work reduces managed and native allocation overhead, improves Android texture presentation, and makes bundled dependencies more reliable on supported platforms.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother front-buffered presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel copies are more efficient** — Optimizes managed image pixel copying to reduce overhead when transferring image data. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text shaping avoids repeated buffer allocation** — Pools the UTF-32 encoding buffer and avoids native feature-string allocations, reducing allocation pressure during HarfBuzz text shaping. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain resources** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention so resources can be released when callers are finished with them. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Linux binds bundled HarfBuzz locally** — Uses the bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux, improving reliability of the packaged native dependency. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **WebAssembly bundles WebGPU support** — Packages emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp in libSkiaSharp.a so WebAssembly native builds include the required WebGPU implementation. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
